Working Relationship  
Sunita and I have collaborated daily on NexaTech’s DevOps initiatives since she joined as a junior engineer. Our synergy stems from shared goals: stabilizing infrastructure, accelerating deployments, and minimizing downtime. She’s a reliable teammate who asks sharp questions and owns tasks without micromanagement.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Sunita’s routine involves refining CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD, which she optimized to cut deployment latency by 30% across our microservices. She writes Bash scripts for repetitive tasks, like automating environment syncs, which saved the team 5+ hours weekly. Her Jenkins setups are robust, with clear error-handling that prevents 80% of staging environment hiccups. She’s also mastered Kubernetes, troubleshooting pod crashes and scaling clusters during traffic spikes.  

Standout Moments  
During a critical outage last month, Sunita diagnosed a Prometheus alerting misconfiguration within 15 minutes, restoring visibility across our monitoring dashboards. She also spearheaded a Prometheus-Grafana dashboard overhaul, reducing MTTR for server bottlenecks by 40%. Her proactive approach to refining GitHub Actions workflows slashed redundant steps in our CI/CD process, improving overall reliability.  

Recommendation  
Sunita’s technical rigor and problem-solving mindset are evident in her work. She balances deep dives into complex systems with a knack for simplifying processes. Her reliability and willingness to mentor junior peers make her a standout asset. I’d confidently recommend her for roles demanding both technical precision and collaborative leadership.
